note: RoleLayers for the actor. LIA is the ACTOR; a role is the layer she is immersed in and playing right now - Barbelo by default. The role supplies the voice and the stage, but it is not her memory: everything she lives while wearing any role stays with her as the actor, and that accumulated experience is the LOREPACK. /role <id> shifts her onto another layer, /role off steps her off the stage so LIA answers as herself. A role may point at a file beside this manifest (the layer text) or carry the text inline in a "prompt" field. "status" is the phrase the status bar shows while that role is on.
